## Outcome

This was not a week of new features. I worked through review comments on PR #288, PR #336, and PR #286. Most of the useful changes were deletions, clearer names, and stronger assertions.

## Context

PRs #288 and #286 began before GSoC, while PR #336 began in Week 2. This entry records only the review revisions I made during Week 9.

## What I Did

- In [PR #288](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/288), removed unrelated setup and skips, then checked the actual space below custom-height facets.
- In [PR #336](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/336), removed the compiler-only parameter before validation and added default-`TRUE` and partial-matching coverage.
- In [PR #286](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/286), removed redundant type checks and rewrote NEWS around the visible `panel.margin` behavior.

## Learnings

Review improved these branches mostly by making them smaller. None of the changes looked dramatic, but the purpose of each test became easier to see.

## Challenges / Notes

The main difficulty was keeping the useful test history without carrying every temporary experiment into the final branch.

## Next Week Targets

Finish the panel-margin review and continue the collaborative `coord_equal` work for wide and tall viewports.
